title: Turán problems with bounded matching number in $k$-uniform hypergraphs
summary: For a family $\mathcal{F}$ of $k$-graphs, $ex_k(n,\mathcal{F})$ denotes the maximum number of edges in an $n$-vertex $\mathcal{F}$-free $k$-graph. Let $M_{s+1}^k$ denote a matching of size $s+1$ in $k$-uniform hypergraphs. Recently, Alon and Frankl (JCTB, 2024) determined $ex_2(n,\{M_{s+1}^2,K_{\ell+1}\})$ for all $n\geq 2s+1$ and $\ell\geq 2$. For every non-bipartite graph $F$, Gerbner (JGT, 2024) determined $ex_2(n,\{M_{s+1}^2,F\})$ for sufficiently large $n$.
